title: 第11章 你好结婚第12章 假冒的系统
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
夏以苜被岳冉粗暴拽着御剑飞行。
她还是第一次体验这种直接飞上天的感觉，没有新奇，只觉得想吐。
她的头对着地面，下方的景象不断略过，拖拽成各种颜色的线条。
岳冉的速度极快，不一会儿，便将她带到了一处裂谷上方。
下方那深不见底的裂谷，直接将眩晕中的夏以苜吓清醒了。
“不是吧……”
下一刻，拎着她的手便毫不留情地松开！
岳冉踩剑悬在空中，看着坠落的夏以苜冷笑。
“去死吧！”
这片地方叫云雾裂谷，谷底奇深无比，至今无人到达过其底部，无数人想探查这里，皆死在其中。
有人说，下面有凶狠的怪物，有人说，下面郁积着无数魔气，总之，云雾裂谷是个可怕的地方。
久而久之，便无人靠近此处。
那凡人落入其中，必死无疑！
夏以苜身体极速下坠，强烈的失重感比刚才的眩晕感还让她难受。
林朔风被那些长老拦着，没有办法来救她，身下便是漆黑的万丈深渊。
以她这点微末的修为，眼下的情况根本没办法自救。
夏以苜的头发被风吹得凌乱，只怕这次她当真是要凶多吉少了。
她才刚活过来，难道又要死一次了吗？
不知道这次还有没有机会再复活，若是不能，林朔风该怎么办？
夏以苜心乱如麻，好在那山崖极深，坠落过程也长，给她留够了思考的时间。

这也意味着，她一旦接触地面，便会直接变成一滩肉泥。
坠地的预感越来越强烈，她不愿就这么放弃挣扎。
竭尽全力调动着身上仅有的灵力，试图在身下凝聚出一个缓冲的护盾。
坠地的那一刻还是来了。
轰——
身体以极快的速度砸向地面！巨大的撞击声响在空旷的裂谷内回荡？
夏以苜心脏狂跳，如此大的威力，她那薄得可怜的缓冲护盾怎么可能有用？
强烈的冲击力震得她觉得自己五脏六腑都要碎掉了！
她的脸痛苦地皱巴成一团，比之前被泥石流淹没还让人难受！
濒死的感觉如潮水将她包围，混合着难言的遗憾，要夺走她一切生机。
迷迷糊糊中，她好像砸穿了什么东西，然后才重重落在了地面上！
content_en:
Xia Yishuo was violently dragged by Yue Ran to fly with his sword.
This was her first time to experience the feeling of flying directly into the sky. There was nothing novel about it, she just felt like vomiting.
Her head was facing the ground, and the scene below kept passing by, dragging it into lines of various colors.
Yue Ran's speed was extremely fast, and after a while, she was brought to the top of a rift valley.
The bottomless rift valley below directly frightened Xia Yixiao out of his daze.
"No..."
The next moment, the hand holding her let go without mercy!
Yue Ran stepped on the sword and hung in the air, looking at Xia Yihuo who fell and sneered.
"Go to hell!"
This place is called the Cloud Rift Valley. The bottom of the valley is so deep that no one has ever reached the bottom. Countless people have died in it while trying to explore it.
Some people say that there are ferocious monsters down there, and some say that there are countless demonic energies smoldering down there. In short, the Cloud Rift Valley is a scary place.
Over time, no one came near this place.
Anyone who falls into it will definitely die!
Xia Yilu's body fell rapidly, and the strong feeling of weightlessness made her even more uncomfortable than the dizziness just now.
Lin Shuofeng was blocked by the elders and had no way to save her. There was a pitch-black abyss beneath her.
With her meager cultivation, there was no way she could save herself from the current situation.
Xia Yilu's hair was messy by the wind, and she was afraid that this time she was really going to be in trouble.
She just came back to life, is she going to die again?
I wonder if there is a chance to be resurrected this time. If not, what should Lin Shuofeng do?
Xia Yilu was in a state of confusion, but fortunately the cliff was extremely deep and the fall process was long, leaving her enough time to think.
This also means that once she touches the ground, she will directly turn into a puddle of flesh.
The premonition of falling to the ground became stronger and stronger, and she was unwilling to just give up her struggle.
He tried his best to mobilize the only spiritual power in his body, trying to condense a buffering shield under his body.
The moment of falling to the ground came.
Boom——
The body hit the ground at an extremely fast speed! A huge crash echoed in the empty rift?
Xia Yilu's heart was beating wildly. With such a powerful force, how could her pitifully thin buffer shield be useful?
The strong impact made her feel like her internal organs were going to be broken!
Her face was wrinkled in pain, which was even more uncomfortable than being submerged by the mudslide before!
The feeling of dying surrounded her like a tide, mixed with unspeakable regret, and wanted to take away all her life.
In a daze, she seemed to have smashed through something, and then fell heavily to the ground!
